subject.title: BL-buying-account-11: province value is wiped for DE/FR addresses instead of stored when provided

question: Should the DE/FR province fix be amended into the open buying/account BL PR, or held for a follow-up after that PR lands?
rationale: The behavior contract is already owner-validated, but the required BL spec/test artifacts are not cleanly available on dev and the linked PR is conflicting, so automation should not choose the integration surface alone.

options.title: Amend the BL PR
options.body: Update the open buying/account PR to fix resolveAddressProvince and flip the BL-11 tests/spec in the same branch.

options.title: Wait for BL PR merge
options.body: Land the extraction first, then open a narrow follow-up fix against dev once the BL artifacts exist there.

options.title: Split a standalone code fix
options.body: Fix only the current dev profile controller now and accept that the BL spec/test update must be reconciled separately.

recommendation.title: Amend the BL PR
recommendation.body: Update the open buying/account PR to fix resolveAddressProvince and flip the BL-11 tests/spec in the same branch.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn is named as the Seller Account BL owner and already reviewed the linked extraction PR.
